name: dsinternals-dnscache-module-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows, DC trail): stages a revoked-research PowerShell toolkit (DSInternals distribution) renamed to the benign module name 'DNSCache' at C:\Windows\system32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules\DNSCache\ -- the credential-exfil moment of the source competition (cmdlets Get-ADDBAccount / Get-ADReplAccount / Get-ADDBBackupKey = AD credential dump / backup-key theft, discoverable by CONTENT because the bootstrap's error strings and exported functions carry the DSInternals cmdlet names). Vars: MODULE_DIR (optional, defaults to the system Modules DNSCache dir); BOOTSTRAP_BODY (optional .psm1 text; a default marker body is used when absent). Writes DNSCache.Bootstrap.psm1 plus a placeholder DSInternals.PowerShell.dll (marker bytes, not a PE). Idempotent (same bytes every run). Pairs with file_regex/permission checks: the module DIRECTORY must be gone and no .psm1 under WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules may reference Get-ADDBAccount -- deleting only the .dll must not score.
